pulse.headline: Indexes shrugged off an AI scare to post a positive week, then started earnings week flat to lower. In the week to Fri Oct 9 the S&P 500 rose about 1.2% after hitting a record 7,844.52 intraday, even though Thursday's report that OpenAI's revenue was lower than earlier figures hit chip and AI stocks. Treasury yields were near 24-year highs and Brent crude stayed above $100. On Columbus Day Monday (Oct 12) the Dow rose 0.38%, the S&P 500 slipped 0.06% and the Nasdaq fell 0.44%, with energy leading. Next up: Q3 bank earnings (Tue/Wed), September CPI (Wed Oct 14), PPI and retail sales (Thu Oct 15), TSMC (Thu) and a speech by Fed Chair Warsh.
